name: Heartseed Inc.
summary: Heartseed Inc. is a Japan-based company researching and developing regenerative medicine products. It has established a cardiac therapy in which microtissue derived from iPS cells is implanted in the heart for people suffering serious heart failure. Conditions it is aimed at are dilated cardiomyopathy, previous myocardial infarction and the dilated phase of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
